value.title: A Different Route
value.synopsis: Chronologically, this episode occurs between episodes four and five of the television broadcast. Koyori wins tickets to a family-oriented spa and water park that just recently opened; Yorito, Koyori, Mana and her friends go together, though Aono has to stay in the hospital. Coincidentally, Takeshi also wins tickets to the spa, and takes Mayuko with him

value.title: Towards the Dawning Sky
value.synopsis: This episode serves as a prologue to the series and leads up to the events at the beginning of episode one
